For certainly, if the reasons for the mitzvos, G-d forbid, are merely conventional, for the sake of maintaining society, etc., as they fabricate from their hearts — then certainly it is impossible to stand up in the battle to conquer one's evil inclination for the sake of this, as is known and understood to anyone who has any familiarity with their evil words — the bitter, the piercing, like the thrusts of a sword — with their bitter taste of the chalamush (poisonous weed) of theirs upon the mitzvos. For the Sitra Achara sharei b'chibura v'sayeim b'feruda (begins with union and ends with separation). They begin with the connection of the letters of the Torah as they are, and they do not want the received tradition of our Sages, of blessed memory. And afterward they come to complete separation, in the aspect of: “And a gossiper separates the chief” (Mishlei 16:28) — they separate the Oral Torah from the Written Torah, until they bring about the throwing off of the yoke entirely, as already many of them have actually converted their religion entirely through this. And those who remain in the name of Israel — it is only superficially, and they throw off the yoke of most of the mitzvos entirely. For all their evil interpretations with which they interpret the Torah according to their way are separated from the true, essential intent of the Written Torah, as any person of understanding who desires the truth will be able to comprehend.

segments.he: אות ח

וזה בחי' ציצית כי ציצית הם בחי' עינים כ"ש (במדבר ט"ו) וראיתם אותו. כי הם בבחי' בגד יישע אסתכלותא כי הכל תאיבין להסתכל בהם בחי' כסות עינים כ"ש שם. וזהו בחי' תכלת כי תכלת הוא התחברות שחור ולבן בחי' כלליות הגוונין. וע"כ המצוה הוא וראיתם אותו כי הכל תאיבין להסתכל בהם כשנכללין הגוונין יחד כנ"ל. וע"כ הציצית הם שמירה מן המזיקין כי ע"י הציצית שהם בחי' גוונין עלאין בחי' בגדי ישע עי"ז נכנעים הקליפות והדמיונות שהן מזיקי עלמא ואזי זוכין לעלות מדרגא לדרגא. וע"כ עיקר תיקון התפלה הוא בציצית ותפילין גם צריכין ליתן צדקה קודם התפילה. כי בשעת התפילה עולין מדרגא לדרגא כידוע שזהו עיקר תיקון התפילה וע"כ צריכין מקודם לגגלות גדןולת הבורא ית' ע"י התגלות הגוונין. וע"כ צריכין ליתן צדקה קודם כדי שיתנהרו הגוונין שיש בכסף וזהב. ואזי כשמתנהרין הגוונין הם נעשין בבחי' בגדי ישעמעיל צדקה בחי' כסות עינים וזהו בחי' ציצית כנ"ל. ואזי נתגלין אורות הגוונין בעצמן וזהו בחי' תפילין שנקראין פאר כי תפילין הם אורות הגוונין בעצמן. וע"י כל אלו הבחי' שהם בחי' הארת גוונין עילאין עי"ז דייקא יכולין להתפלל התפילה כתיקונה ולהעלות כל העולמות מדרגא לדרגא כי עיקר כל העליות ע"י התגלות הגוונין כנ"ל:
segments.en: But we who walk in the footsteps of our fathers and our masters, from time immemorial — all the drushim and all the chiddushim, etc., and all the intentions and the secrets, etc. — they are all to strengthen and fortify and arouse the hearts of the children of Israel to fulfill all the mitzvos with even greater vigor, with fear and love and wondrous arousal. For even one who does not understand the ways of the secrets and the allusions understands from afar that there are hidden mysteries, awesome and exalted, in every law and in every particular detail of every mitzvah. For everything returns to one place, for the Written Torah and the Oral Torah are all one, for “Hashem — He is the Elokim,” as mentioned above. Blessed is our G-d who created us for His glory and separated us from these errant ones, and gave us a Torah of truth, etc. And this is the aspect of: “The wisdoms of women have built her house, but foolishness tears it down with her own hands” (Mishlei 14:1). This is said regarding the true wisdom of the Torah, which is called eishes chayil (a woman of valor), the aspect of “the wisdoms of women,” etc. And conversely, the foolishness of the investigators of nature, who are referred to throughout Seifer Mishlei by the name of the strange woman, the adulteress, the foolish woman — as is explained in Rashi and in all the books of the true commentators. For a literal harlot and the heresies of the investigators of nature are actually the same aspect, according to all the above. And likewise, an eishes chayil, a wise and proper wife, is the same aspect as the holy faith that is clarified through the wisdom of the Torah, which is the true wisdom. And this is: “The wisdoms of women have built her house” — the aspect of the wondrous houses that are made through the many permutations without end, which are all built and founded in firmness and strength, since they all return to one place — to fulfill the Torah and the mitzvos, as mentioned above. But: “And foolishness” — which is the investigators of nature — “tears it down with her own hands,” for they wish to tear down all the wondrous aforementioned houses, since all their words are to distance from the truth of the Torah, as mentioned above. And this is why the k'subah and the get begin with: “On such-and-such a day of the week,” etc., according to the counting that we count from the creation of the world — to reveal in them the faith of the renewal of the world. For this is the essential faith that is clarified through the true tzadik, from which comes the entire tikkun of the union at its root, as mentioned above. And likewise regarding divorce — he must divorce her and separate her from her root in him, and it is impossible to separate her except according to the law of Moshe and Israel. That is, through the Torah, which is the aspect of the generality of the spirit of prophecy that clarifies faith, from which comes the union, as mentioned above. And therefore one must ascend there in order to effect the separation from there. For she is not his destined match, since they have come to the point of separation such that he divorces her. For when she is not his destined match and there are many quarrels between them until they cannot reconcile their minds — and all the more so when he has found in her actual ervas davar (a matter of immorality) — then it is impossible to effect through them the unification of nature and Providence, etc., as mentioned above. For sometimes the investigators of nature become clever against the truth of Providence, which is the aspect of: “The adulteress — under her husband she takes strangers” (Yechezkel 16:32) — who turn away from the truth of faith and go after foreign opinions, etc. And from there is drawn all the damage even in the physical realm between the couples, until he is compelled to divorce her. And then he must separate her from her root, as mentioned above. For every man and woman are the aspect of particular intellects who need to receive from each other specifically — just as it is at the root, in the knowledge of the Torah and its secrets, where each one needs to receive from the intellect that pertains to him specifically. And if he receives from another intellect that does not pertain to him, he can cause great damage. And therefore one truly needs a very great and distinguished Rabbi who can illuminate each and every person according to his intellect, according to the time and the level that is his. And from there is the root of husband and wife, giver and receiver, as mentioned above — that the soul of this wife needs to receive from this husband specifically. And when she does not pertain to him, from there come the divorces. And therefore the get must be in writing, and must mention therein the faith of the renewal of the world, as mentioned above, and according to the law of Moshe and Israel — to indicate that he separates her only from himself, for she does not pertain to him. But she is still bound according to the law of the holy Torah, and she has permission to marry whomever she wishes and to be rectified through him. And therefore the get is called a seifer (book/scroll), for it receives from the aspect of Seifer HaTorah (the Torah scroll). And the get serves her as proof and as witness that she has not been separated, G-d forbid, from the Torah entirely — only from this particular man. But she is still bound to the Torah, for she has been released from him according to the law of Moshe and Israel, etc., as mentioned above. And this is the aspect of yibum (levirate marriage) and chalitzah (removal of the shoe). For it is already explained that the essential purpose of begetting is in order to multiply a soul from Israel, through which the houses multiply greatly, etc. And the essential begetting is drawn at its root from the aspect of the spirit of the tzadik, which is the aspect of the spirit of prophecy, through which the imaginative faculty is clarified, through which faith is clarified — which is the aspect of “a G-d-fearing woman” — from which come all the begettings. And the more that a soul from Israel is born, it is the aspect of the renewal of the world, for man is a microcosm. And every person is the aspect of an entirely new matter and a completely new intellect, as is explained in our words elsewhere — that even a gilgul (reincarnation) is not reincarnated exactly as he was originally, but rather this nefesh with this ruach, etc. And it is all for the sake of publicizing and revealing His faithfulness, blessed be He, in the aspect of: “And from generation to generation is His faithfulness” (Tehillim 100:5).

segments.he: אות ט

וזה שכתב רבינו ז"ל במאמר הנ"ל שבביהמ"ק הי' שבירת המדמה שהוא רוח הבהמיות כי שם היו מקריבין הקרבנות וכו' ע"ש. כי בביהמ"ק היו כלולים כל הגוונין עילאין זהב וכסף ונחשת ותכלת וכו' שהם כלל כל הגוונין שכולם היו כלולים בבית המקדש, ועל ידי זה שם דייקא היו מקריבין כל הקרבנות שהם בחי' הכנעת המדמה והקלית כי עיקר הכנעתם ע"י התגלות הגוונין כנ"ל. וע"כ ביהמ"ק גבוה מכל הארצות כ"ש וקמת ועלית וכו' כי שם כל העליות של הקדושה כי העליות כולם מדרגא לדרגא הם ע"י הביהמ"ק ששם הוא בחי' כלליות הגוונין שעי"ז מכניעין הקליפות שבכל דרגא ודרגא שהם בחי' כח המדמה רוח הבהמיות כנ"ל. ועי"ז יכולין לעלות מדרגא לדרגא כנ"ל. וזה בחי' שלש פעמים בשנה יראה כל זכורך את פני ה' אלהיך וכו' ולא יראו פני ריקם, כי שלש רגלים הם כנגד אברהם יצחק ויעקב שהם בחי' כלליות הגוונין כי עיקר הגוונין הם תלת בחי' שלשה אבות כידוע, ואז צריכין לעלות וליראות את פני ה' כי אז בהשלש רגים נתגלה כביכול בחי' פני ה' שזהו בחי' הארות הגוונין שהם בחי' פאר שזהו בח'י יעקב שהוא בחי' פנים בחי' כללות הגוונין ועיקר ההתגלות בביהמ"ק ששם הארת כל הגוונין, אך לא יראו פני ה' ריקם כי צריך להביא מממונו קרבנות איש כמתנת ידו כברכת ה' וכו', וע"י אלו הקרבנות שמביא כ"א מממונו ויגיע כפי עי"ז נתתקן כל ממונו כמו ע"י צדקה כי צדקה הוא גם כן בחי'קרבן כמובא, ואזי מאירין הגוונין שיש בכסף וזהב ועי"ז וזכה כ"א לפי בחינתו לעלות ולראות את פני ה'. כי הגוונין עילאין מאירין ע"י הקרבנות שמביא כ"א מממונו שעי"ז נתתקן כל ממונו ומאיירן הגוונין המלובשים שם כנ"ל. וזהו בחי' ולא יראו פני ריקם הנאמר ברגלים כשעולין להביהמ"ק לראות את פני ה' כנ"ל: בילא"ו:
segments.en: And the more that souls multiply and the house of prayer grows greater through the multiplication of houses, etc., through this the aspect of the spirit of prophecy grows greater. For the spirit of prophecy comes from the souls of Israel, as is explained there. Therefore, the more that the permutations of souls multiply, the spirit of prophecy that comes from them grows and increases all the more. And through this one can beget yet more souls, more and more, who will reveal the faith even more. And so it goes, round and round. And through this the redemption will come, as mentioned above — for the son of David will not come until all the souls in the guf (the celestial repository of souls) are completed. And through all of the above is drawn the voice of the melody that is explained there — which waters the garden, etc. — through which the akeiv d'kedushah (the “heel” of holiness) prevails over the akeiv d'Sitra Achara (the “heel” of the Other Side), in the aspect of: “And his hand grasped the heel of Esav” (Bereishis 25:26), as is explained there; see there well. And this is the aspect of the musical instruments that are played at a wedding. For the essential purpose of the wedding is for the sake of begetting, etc. — through which is drawn the aforementioned voice of melody. And one who dies without children, may the Merciful One save us, is blemished in all of the above. And therefore he does not enter the pargod d'Malka (the curtain of the King), as it is in the holy Zohar. And therefore his soul remains bound to the heel of his brother, as is brought. For the blemish reaches as far as there — to the aspect of the akeiv (heel) — in that he did not merit to spread forth and to beget, through which all the aforementioned tikkunim would have been made, until the aspect of the akeiv d'kedushah (heel of holiness) would have been rectified, as mentioned above. And therefore his soul is bound there, in the aspect of the heel. And therefore his tikkun is through his brother, who is adjacent to him in the permutations of the letters. For the six hundred thousand souls of Israel are the aspect of the six hundred thousand letters of the Torah, and every individual of Israel has a letter in the Torah, and every letter is comprised of all the letters. And likewise, every soul is comprised of all the souls — only that its essence is grasped in this letter. And just as in the Torah there are parashiyos and p'sukim and words and letters, so too among the souls there are tribes and families and ancestral houses, etc. And each person together with his brother is like a single word in the Torah that has several letters — so too in his father's house there are several souls of his brothers. It follows that his brother is adjacent to him in the aforementioned permutations of the letters. Therefore he has the power to redeem him through the secret of yibum. And the essential tikkun of yibum is through the aspect of hahu rucha d'shadei b'gavah (that spirit which he casts into her) — that is, the aspect of the spirit of prophecy mentioned above, which is drawn at its root from the tzadik, from which comes begetting, as mentioned above. And therefore through hahu rucha (that spirit) he can rectify him, for he is reformed and refashioned through hahu rucha — through which faith is clarified and one merits the aspect of the renewal of the world, from which comes the tikkun. And therefore, when he does not wish to perform yibum, then: “She shall remove his shoe from upon his foot” (Devarim 25:9) — to show him that he has blemished in the aspect of the akeiv (heel), as mentioned above. For all the blemish is drawn from the sin of Adam HaRishon, in that he did not merit to rectify it according to his portion. And the essential sin and blemish of Adam HaRishon was in the aspect of the akeiv — through the serpent who was cunning, from which come all the damages, as is explained in the aforementioned Torah. For through this he caused: “And you shall bruise him on the heel” (Bereishis 3:15) — from which comes the power of the heel of Esav, which is the contamination of the serpent. And the tikkun is through the voice of the melody explained there, which is drawn through the clarification of faith, etc., which is the aspect of: “I heard Your voice in the garden, and I was afraid” (Bereishis 3:10), as is explained there. And then, after the tikkun began, it is written: “And Hashem Elokim made for Adam and for his wife garments of skin, and He clothed them” (Bereishis 3:21) — the secret of the shoes, as is brought. And therefore this yavam (levir) who does not wish to perform yibum, and this indicates that he does not have the power to draw all the aforementioned tikkunim — therefore: “She shall remove his shoe from upon his foot,” etc., and she shall answer and say: “So shall it be done to the man who will not build up his brother's house,” etc. (Devarim 25:9). For there is the blemish in the aspect of the shoes, which are the aspect of the garments of skin, which are the aspect of the tikkun of the heel, as mentioned above. And this is: “And she shall spit in his face” (Devarim 25:9) — which is the aspect of disgrace, the opposite of kavod (honor). For the spirit of prophecy mentioned above is drawn from kavod, as is explained there. And therefore this one who has blemished in this has blemished in kavod. And therefore: “she shall spit in his face” — which is the opposite of kavod. May it be His will that He save us and all His people Israel, that they should not come to chalitzah and yibum. And may it speedily be fulfilled: “The smallest shall become a thousand, and the youngest a mighty nation; I am Hashem — in its time I will hasten it” (Yeshayah 60:22). Blessed is Hashem forever, Amein and Amein. “Hashem shall reign forever; your G-d, O Tziyon, from generation to generation, Halleluyah!” (Tehillim 146:10)
